Cockpit

This small room is filled with controls that look like they're used to pilot an aircraft, or perhaps a spacecraft. Maybe it's used for simulators? The controls are all identified by archaic markings that have been crossed out and replaced with more familiar names. There's also a sheet of paper, but with your luck they won't be directions at all.
